questionSnapshot.question: Which Walt Disney World theme park is centered on wildlife habitats and conservation?

notes: q103 and q348 test specific attraction locations, not the park’s defining wildlife purpose. Easy recognition. Checked all four final options, mobile wording, clue fairness, category, editorial difficulty and theatrical/character/park scope. Full topic digests and additional all-shard searches were used for distinctness; context questions are not approved by this review.
